_comment: Planner configuration file. Every setting the CLI exposes as a flag has a default here, so this file doubles as documentation. Comment keys ("_comment") are ignored on load. Each section is optional; missing sections and keys fall back to built-in defaults. Copy to planner.json and edit. CLI flags always override these values.

defaults._comment: Default values applied when creating a new story. Override any of these to change what "planner story --name ..." fills in when the corresponding flag is not given.

display._comment: How results are rendered and how often the TUI auto-refreshes. "format" accepts: text, json, csv, id-only. "auto_refresh_seconds" sets the TUI's auto-refresh interval.

backup._comment: Automatic backup rotation for planner.db. "rotate_backup" keeps this many most-recent rotated backups before pruning; "keep" is how many of the most recent backups to retain when running a manual backup.

database._comment: Path to the SQLite database file. A relative path is resolved against the directory containing this config file; an absolute path is used as-is. Leave empty to use the default planner.db.
